Cockpit is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2019 to 2019.

What it was for: [Systems and infrastructure](@/projects/systems.md) (2).

Most recently: [server-archlinux](@/work/server-archlinux.md); [server-atomic](@/work/server-atomic.md): Server powered by Project Atomic.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Cockpit: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Cockpit to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
